purpose: Metadata-only intervention feasibility. Not image inference, method validation or natural-weather validation.
data: ViLD Zenodo record 19223815, official test splits for flight10/vild and flight09/vild_09
spatial_rule: Fixed UTM grid floor(easting/500),floor(northing/500); seed permutes cells. Select shortest cumulative cell prefix reaching target entry count; whole cells are removed.
matched_random_rule: Uniform sample without replacement of exactly the same number of gallery entries removed by the corresponding spatial case.
outcome: Query has zero retained gallery candidates within each published-reference radius. Report repeated-mask counts separately from independent sites.
selection_timing: After metadata audit found many positives per query; before intervention outcomes or any image scores. This is a follow-up design, not untouched-data confirmation.
constraints: No p values across masks as if sites
No weather or condition labels inferred
No alteration of original SUES or DenseUAV gates
